name: Venomancer: Unbreakable stack cap and Empowering Pheromones potency (#2924, #2927)
contract: Issues #2924 (Unbreakable 705991) and #2927 (Empowering Pheromones 705996), both classified works-natively; regression scenario. Spell.dbc: 705991 is family 35 with two ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) effects, both with EffectSpellClassMask (0,0,0x4000000) which is the SpellFamilyFlags of Exposed Flesh 805095 (StackAmount 10, effect 0 aura 87 MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN misc 1 physical, BasePoints 2 DieSides 1 = 3). Effect 0 is misc 31 SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS BasePoints 4 (+5), read by SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks, which Aura stack changes and the module's Expose() both call. Effect 1 is misc 3 SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 BasePoints -2 DieSides 1 (-1), read by SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue through Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, so the per-stack amount goes 3 -> 2; AuraEffect::CalculateAmount multiplies by stack count (10 stacks: 30 control, 20 talent; 15 stacks: 30), and the Physical damage taken bonus follows. 705996 has two ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108) effects with mask (0,4096,0): misc 8 SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS BasePoints 19 (+20%) and misc 1 SPELLMOD_DURATION BasePoints 49 (+50%). Every Spider/Beetle/Toxic Pheromones row carries SpellFamilyFlags (0,4096,0). Spider Pheromones rank 2 (803306): effect 0 aura 29 MOD_STAT misc 1 (Agility) BasePoints 19 DieSides 1 = 20, DurationIndex 30 = 1,800,000 ms (SpellDuration.dbc); 20 * 1.2 = 24 exactly and 1,800,000 * 1.5 = 2,700,000. Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies SPELLMOD_DURATION for the caster's spell mod owner. Numbers were read from /srv/coa/server-data/dbc Spell.dbc and SpellDuration.dbc. Each talent is compared against an identical control character; Wilt (804982, flags (64,0,0)) is the negative control for both masks. The 'hitter' creature only supplies an attacker unit for the incoming-damage calculation; it is passive.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Exposed Flesh caps at 10 stacks without Unbreakable
Exposed Flesh's per-stack Physical damage taken is 3% without Unbreakable
No stack-cap modifier on Exposed Flesh before Unbreakable
Unbreakable actor: physical damage taken base
Control: physical damage taken base
Unbreakable adds a flat 5 to Exposed Flesh's stack cap
Exposed Flesh now caps at 15 stacks
Unbreakable adds a flat -1 to Exposed Flesh's first effect
Exposed Flesh's per-stack Physical damage taken is 2% with Unbreakable
Unbreakable does not touch an unrelated Venomancer spell (Wilt) stack cap or first effect
Control: 10 Exposed Flesh stacks
Unbreakable actor: 10 Exposed Flesh stacks
Control applies 10 stacks
Control: 10 stacks at 3% carry 30
Unbreakable actor: 10 stacks at 2% carry 20
Control takes 30% more Physical damage at 10 stacks
Unbreakable actor takes 20% more Physical damage at 10 stacks
Unbreakable actor: 15 Exposed Flesh stacks (above the base cap)
Fifteen stacks are accepted
15 stacks at 2% carry 30
Unbreakable actor takes 30% more Physical damage at 15 stacks
Spider Pheromones rank 2 grants 20 Agility without Empowering Pheromones
No all-effects modifier on Pheromones before the talent
No duration modifier on Pheromones before the talent
Empowering Pheromones adds +20% to all effects of a Pheromone
Empowering Pheromones adds +50% to a Pheromone's duration
The Pheromone mask also reaches Beetle Pheromones (803651)
Empowering Pheromones does not raise an unrelated spell (Wilt) effect
Spider Pheromones rank 2 would now grant 24 Agility
Control receives Spider Pheromones rank 2
Empowered actor receives Spider Pheromones rank 2 cast by itself
Control's applied aura carries 20
Empowered aura carries 24
Control's aura lasts the DBC 30 minutes
Empowered aura lasts 45 minutes
